title: 封闭车队口径与中心值

caliber.decision: closed fleet: 10-24 May is one batch of bicycles

truncation_check.conclusion: 5/20-5/24 is a truncated sample, not a behaviour change: volume is 54.5% of 10-19 May, distinct bicycles 63.1%, 13 whole hour-blocks are missing (5/20 19-22; 5/23 9,10,19; 5/24 9,10,19-23), and the daily totals are 46-76% of the full-day rate even inside covered hours. The hourly shape differs from the full days (corr 0.65-0.78, max 6-10 pp), so the paper's 'indistinguishable' wording at sec3:32-33 is not supported. Missing whole hours are why the day cannot be refitted as if it were a uniform 54.5% subsample.

A_9day_unseen_on_14day_union.note: upper reference; overstates the 14-day unseen share

B_chapman_9day_vs_5day.note: central candidate; heterogeneity biases down, truncated second window biases up

refit_on_14_days.reason: the 5/20-5/24 days are not uniform subsamples: 13 whole hour-blocks are absent and the within-covered-hour volume is 46-76% of the full-day rate, so a 14-day usage-rate fit would mix truncated-day capture probabilities with real usage. The 9-day + union route and the two-window capture-recapture avoid fitting a usage distribution to the truncated days.
refit_on_14_days.difference_if_forced: a naive 14-day refit would make the low-volume days look like low-usage days and bias the estimated mean trips per bicycle downward, which inflates F; no such estimate is used.

central.interval_note: lower = observed 14-day union (hard bound); upper = method A (normalised reference); not a sampling CI
central.interval_endpoint_decision: for the acceptance session; this delivery does not choose which end to adopt

notes: 不重跑 Q2-Q5；Q2 的成本/卡车数只做 alpha 标签换算，物理车队点 274,910 不变。
区间下端是 14 天观测并集（硬下界），上端是方法 A（高估未见份额），不是抽样置信区间；Chapman 抽样 95% CI 仅 ±260 辆，模型不确定性主导。
方法 B 的第二窗口 5/20-5/24 是截断样本（单量 54.5%、单车数 63.1%、13 个零订单小时），这会降低 n2 与重叠 m、抬高 Chapman；异质性则压低 Chapman，两向部分抵消。
未测分支：按日分批投放的开放模型；若车队可跨城市调动，14 天并集不再是下界。
The 5/20-24 window is used only through presence/absence (capture-recapture); no usage-rate distribution is fitted on it.
The interval is a model-uncertainty envelope, not a sampling CI: the Chapman sampling 95% CI is 495,283-495,797, while the method envelope is 484,754-506,635.
The paper passage sec9:35-37 ('within 4%') is a separate T002 finding and is not changed here.
